name: Black City Tote
tagline: A structured everyday tote bag with quiet city polish.
description: This black leather tote bag holds a laptop, a book, and the rest of a working day without losing its line. A structured work bag and office bag with unlacquered brass hardware, a split interior so keys never vanish into the same pocket as papers, and enough room for a daily commute.
materials: Full-grain Italian leather, cotton twill lining, brass hardware
strap: Dual top handles with an optional 110 cm shoulder strap

name: Brown Work Tote
tagline: Warm brown leather that only looks better after a season of use.
description: A studio favorite. This brown leather tote bag is built for commutes and long lunches: a padded 15-inch laptop bag sleeve, a zip pocket for documents, and a work bag leather that deepens as it wears. A reliable office bag and everyday tote bag dyed in small batches.
materials: Vegetable-tanned cowhide, suede-lined laptop sleeve, antique brass

name: Cream Quilted Shoulder
tagline: Soft quilting, cream leather, and an evening-ready line.
description: A cream leather shoulder bag, diamond-quilted by hand and finished with a turn-lock that clicks closed rather than snaps. This ladies handbag and evening bag is meant for dinners, galleries, and any hour you want a quilted shoulder bag to feel like part of the outfit instead of an afterthought.
materials: Nappa leather, silk-blend lining, gold-tone hardware

name: Red Mini Quilt
tagline: A small red bag in a color that does the talking.
description: This red mini bag is sized for a phone, a card case, and lipstick — nothing more, on purpose. A compact clutch bag and small handbag with aniline-dyed leather so the red stays rich in daylight and candlelight alike. A magnetic flap keeps this quilted mini bag clean.
materials: Aniline-dyed lambskin, microfiber lining, gold-tone hardware

name: Green Compact Crossbody
tagline: Hands-free green leather, built for all-day wear.
description: A compact green crossbody bag that sits easily against linen, denim, and black. This sling bag and everyday crossbody bag has a strap wide enough to stay put, a suede-lined flap, and a front pocket cut for a transit card you can reach without opening the bag.
materials: Pebbled calfskin, suede flap lining, nickel hardware

name: Blue Commuter Backpack
tagline: A blue city backpack that still reads as considered.
description: A blue backpack with leather trim, a padded back panel, and a sleeve that slides over a suitcase handle. This travel bag and commuter backpack is made for people who walk more than they drive: weather-resistant cloth, a hidden zip at the top, and straps that do not bite. A light traveller bag for daily use.
materials: Waxed cotton canvas, vegetable-tanned trim, YKK hardware
strap: Padded shoulder straps with a sternum clip

name: Tan Saddle Bag
tagline: A classic saddle bag in sun-warmed tan leather.
description: This tan leather saddle bag sits at the hip with a flap that folds like a letter. A classic shoulder bag and everyday handbag whose leather is pulled-up so scuffs become part of the surface rather than damage. Inside: one zip pocket, two slip pockets, and enough room for a compact umbrella.
materials: Pulled-up cowhide, cotton lining, darkened brass

name: Dark Green Weekender
tagline: Two nights away, packed with room to spare.
description: A generous dark green traveller bag and weekender bag, structured enough to stand on its own and soft enough to crush into an overhead locker. This travel bag and duffel bag has a reinforced base, a two-way zip, and a trolley sleeve so it stacks on a larger case.
materials: Corrected-grain leather, canvas lining, antique brass zip
strap: Rolled handles and a detachable shoulder strap

name: Pink Mini Hobo
tagline: A slouch of pink leather for lighter days.
description: This pink mini bag is gathered at the top so it slumps just enough. A soft hobo bag and small shoulder bag in pale pink leather that reads brighter in sunlight and softer under indoor light. A magnetic snap hides in the gather — a quiet ladies handbag with no hardware shouting from the front.
materials: Soft nappa, micro suede lining, hidden magnet

name: Dark Brown Satchel
tagline: A dark brown satchel with a lock, a flap, and a serious interior.
description: A dark brown leather satchel bag with a belted flap and a lock that is decorative until you decide it is not. This messenger bag and work satchel is the bag we recommend for anyone carrying a notebook they care about: rigid sides, a pen loop, and a base that does not sag on a café table.
materials: Drum-dyed cowhide, suede lining, brass lock

name: Beige Canvas Tote
tagline: A lighter tote bag for markets, libraries, and weekends.
description: A beige canvas tote bag with leather handles and a snap-close inner pouch. This everyday tote bag and shopping bag is the least precious bag we make, on purpose — washable lining, a wide mouth, and a price that invites daily use. Still inspected twice, still stitched in the same studio.
materials: 12 oz cotton canvas, vegetable-tanned handles, snap pouch

name: Wine Crossbody
tagline: Wine-dark leather for evenings that run long.
description: A slim wine leather crossbody bag, cut close to the body. This sling bag and evening crossbody bag leaves the front panel unadorned; the color is the ornament. Inside, a zip divide keeps coins from mixing with keys. Wear it high for dinner or lengthen the strap for walking home.
